title.value: BARVINN: Arbitrary Precision DNN Accelerator Controlled by a RISC-V CPU
title.justification: The paper introduces and analyzes the BARVINN DNN accelerator, which is focused on arbitrary precision controlled by a RISC-V CPU.
title.quote: We present a DNN accelerator that allows inference at arbitrary precision with dedicated processing elements that are configurable at the bit level.

extractions.description: BARVINN is a deep neural network (DNN) accelerator designed for arbitrary precision computations, controlled by an embedded RISC-V CPU, and implemented on FPGA platforms for efficiency. It facilitates scalable throughput and programmable configurations without requiring hardware reconfiguration, making it versatile for various DNN models at different quantization levels. The project is open-source and aims to optimize low-power operations while maintaining high precision performance.
